test_name: Access API Documentation from Login Page
description: Validate that the 'Documentation' link on the login page navigates the user to the correct API documentation page.
steps: Verify that the 'Documentation' link is visible in the footer section of the page.
Verify that the user is redirected to https://docs.roost.ai.
Check that the API documentation page loads completely and displays relevant content.
expected_results: The user is redirected to https://docs.roost.ai.
The API documentation page loads successfully.
edge_cases: The 'Documentation' link is broken or incorrectly configured.
The API documentation page is down.
Network connectivity issues prevent page navigation.
JavaScript is disabled, affecting link functionality.
The user clicks the link multiple times in quick succession.
data_requirements: A valid URL for the API documentation page.
No ad blockers or browser extensions interfering with navigation.
dependencies: The 'Documentation' link must be correctly configured.
The API documentation page must be operational.
The footer section must render correctly on the login page.
performance_metrics: Time taken to navigate to the API documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Documentation' link is keyboard accessible.
Verify that the link text is announced correctly by screen readers.
Check color contrast ratios for the link text.
